namespace Web
{
struct WebFileServer
{
    struct Args_GetFile
    {
        std::filesystem::path p{};
    };
    struct Args_GetStream
    {
        std::filesystem::path p{};
    };
    struct Interface
    {
        Interface()          = default;
        virtual ~Interface() = default;

        virtual ::Stencil::websvc::File GetFile(
            std::filesystem::path const& p
            ) = 0;
        virtual ::Stencil::websvc::Stream GetStream(
            std::filesystem::path const& p
            ) = 0;
    };

    template <typename TImpl> struct Svc : public Stencil::InterfaceT<Svc<TImpl>>
    {
        using Impl      = TImpl;
        using BaseClass = Stencil::InterfaceT<Svc<TImpl>>;

        public:
        Svc()  = default;
        ~Svc() = default;
        CLASS_DELETE_COPY_AND_MOVE(Svc);

        struct Dummy
        {};

        using ObjectStore = Stencil::Database::Database<
            >;
        ::Stencil::websvc::File GetFile([[maybe_unused]] Args_GetFile const& args)
        {
            return this->GetFile(
                args.p
            );
        }

        ::Stencil::websvc::File GetFile([[maybe_unused]] Args_GetFile&& args)
        {
            return this->GetFile(
                std::move(args.p)
            );
        }

        ::Stencil::websvc::Stream GetStream([[maybe_unused]] Args_GetStream const& args)
        {
            return this->GetStream(
                args.p
            );
        }

        ::Stencil::websvc::Stream GetStream([[maybe_unused]] Args_GetStream&& args)
        {
            return this->GetStream(
                std::move(args.p)
            );
        }

        ObjectStore objects;

        // static std::unique_ptr<WebFileServer::Svc<TImpl>> Create();
        // static std::shared_ptr<WebFileServer::Svc<TImpl>> CreateShared();
        // static std::shared_ptr<WebFileServer::Svc<TImpl>> Activate();
    };
};

}    // namespace Web

template <> struct Stencil::TypeTraits<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>
{
    using Categories = std::tuple<Stencil::Category::Indexable>;
};

template <> struct Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>
{
    using TObj = Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile;
    enum class Fields
    {
        Invalid,
        arg_p,
    };

    struct Field_arg_pT
    {};
    using Key = Fields;

    static constexpr bool HasDefaultValueForKey(TObj const& /* obj */, Field_arg_pT /* key */) { return false; }
};

template <>
struct Stencil::EnumTraits<Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>::Fields>
{
    using Enum = Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>::Fields;
    SUPPRESS_WARNINGS_START
    SUPPRESS_CLANG_WARNING("-Wunsafe-buffer-usage")
    static constexpr std::string_view Names[] /* NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-avoid-c-arrays,modernize-avoid-c-arrays)*/ = {
        "Invalid",
        "p",
    };

    static std::string_view ToString(Enum type) { return Names[static_cast<size_t>(type)]; }
    SUPPRESS_WARNINGS_END
    static Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>::Fields
    ForIndex(size_t index)
    {
        return static_cast<Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>::Fields>(
            index);
    }
};

template <>
struct Stencil::Visitor<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>
    : Stencil::VisitorT<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>
{
    using TData  = Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile;
    using Traits = Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<TData>;
    using Fields = Traits::Fields;

    template <typename T, typename TLambda>
    static void VisitKey([[maybe_unused]] T& obj, Fields field, [[maybe_unused]] TLambda const& lambda)
    {
        switch (field)
        {
        case Fields::arg_p: return lambda(obj.p);
        case Fields::Invalid: [[fallthrough]];
        default: throw std::logic_error("Invalid Key");
        }
    }

    template <typename T, typename TField, typename TLambda>
    static void VisitKey([[maybe_unused]] T& obj, TField /* field */, [[maybe_unused]] TLambda const& lambda)
    {
        if constexpr (std::is_same_v<TField, typename Traits::Field_arg_pT>) { return lambda(obj.p); }
        throw std::logic_error("Invalid Key");
    }

    template <typename T, typename TLambda> static void VisitAll([[maybe_unused]] T& obj, [[maybe_unused]] TLambda const& lambda)
    {
        lambda(Fields::arg_p, obj.p);
    }
};

template <>
struct Stencil::Comparator<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile,
                           Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>
{
    using ThisType = Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile;
    static bool AreEqual([[maybe_unused]] ThisType const& obj1, [[maybe_unused]] ThisType const& obj2)
    {
        return true
               && Stencil::AreEqual(obj1.p, obj2.p)
            ;
    }
};

template <> struct Stencil::InterfaceApiTraits<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile>
{
    using ArgsStruct = Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetFile;
    static constexpr bool             IsStatic() { return false; }
    static constexpr std::string_view Name() { return "GetFile"; }

    template <typename TImpl> static auto Invoke(TImpl& instance, [[maybe_unused]] ArgsStruct& args)
    {
        return InterfaceSvcTraits<TImpl, Web::WebFileServer>::QueryInterface(instance).GetFile(
            args.p
        );
    }
};

template <>
struct Stencil::Visitor<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetStream>
    : Stencil::VisitorT<Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetStream>
{
    using TData  = Web::WebFileServer::Args_GetStream;
    using Traits = Stencil::TypeTraitsForIndexable<TData>;
    using Fields = Traits::Fields;

    template <typename T, typename TLambda>
    static void VisitKey([[maybe_unused]] T& obj, Fields field, [[maybe_unused]] TLambda const& lambda)
    {
        switch (field)
        {
        case Fields::arg_p: return lambda(obj.p);
        case Fields::Invalid: [[fallthrough]];
        default: throw std::logic_error("Invalid Key");
        }
    }

    template <typename T, typename TField, typename TLambda>
    static void VisitKey([[maybe_unused]] T& obj, TField /* field */, [[maybe_unused]] TLambda const& lambda)
    {
        if constexpr (std::is_same_v<TField, typename Traits::Field_arg_pT>) { return lambda(obj.p); }
        throw std::logic_error("Invalid Key");
    }

    template <typename T, typename TLambda> static void VisitAll([[maybe_unused]] T& obj, [[maybe_unused]] TLambda const& lambda)
    {
        lambda(Fields::arg_p, obj.p);
    }
};

    {
        return true
               && Stencil::AreEqual(obj1.p, obj2.p)
            ;
    }
};
